Pass this flag to output an image sequence instead of a video. The default image format is JPEG. See [`setImageSequence()`](/docs/config#setimagesequence) for more details.

## CLI flag

Use `--sequence` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                               | Flag         |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render) | `--sequence` |

| [Configuration file](/docs/config#setimagesequence) | `Config.setImageSequence()` |
